metadata.title: NJ Municipal Taxpayer Watchdog - Data Sources & Provenance Registry
metadata.complianceStandard: Zero-tolerance for synthetic or estimated data (MISTAKES.md)

datasets.name: Real Property Assessment Rolls (Class 2 Residential)
datasets.sourceAgency: State of New Jersey Office of GIS (NJOGIS) & NJ Division of Taxation
datasets.legalAuthority: NJ MOD-IV Property Tax System (N.J.A.C. 18:12-1.1 et seq.)
datasets.verificationCheck: Check for zero forbidden interior fields (no bedrooms, bathrooms, squareFeet, garage). Must match MOD-IV roll count.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: NJ Division of Taxation & NJOGIS MOD-IV ArcGIS FeatureServer Roll (Parcels_Composite_NJ_WM)
datasets.verificationMethodology: 100% record match on PAMS_PIN, Block, and Lot. Strict automated regex scans confirming complete absence of synthetic interior fields (bedrooms, bathrooms, squareFeet, garage). Calculation consistency verified against certified municipal tax rates.

datasets.name: Certified Property Tax Rate Breakdown & Equalization
datasets.sourceAgency: County Boards of Taxation (Passaic, Morris, Essex, Bergen)
datasets.primaryDocument: Abstract of Ratables (Form SR-3A) & Table of Equalized Valuations
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: County Boards of Taxation (Passaic, Morris, Essex, Bergen) Form SR-3A (Certified Abstract of Ratables)
datasets.verificationMethodology: Component verification: School Rate + Municipal Rate + County Rate strictly equals Certified Total Rate to the third decimal place. Equalization ratios reconciled against Division of Taxation Table of Equalized Valuations.

datasets.name: Adopted Municipal Budget & Appropriations
datasets.sourceAgency: NJ Department of Community Affairs (DCA), Division of Local Government Services (DLGS)
datasets.legalAuthority: Local Budget Law (N.J.S.A. 40A:4-1 et seq.) & User-Friendly Budget Rules (N.J.A.C. 5:30-3.8)
datasets.refreshCadence: Annual (CY April/May adoption, SFY August/September adoption)
datasets.verificationCheck: Sum of major appropriations and revenues reconciles to totalBudget.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: NJ Department of Community Affairs (DCA) Division of Local Government Services (DLGS) Certified Adopted User-Friendly Budgets
datasets.verificationMethodology: Line-item reconciliation: Total appropriations and tax levies match municipal budget filings under N.J.A.C. 5:30-3.8. Police, Fire, DPW, Debt Service, Health Insurance, and Pension line items checked against certified ordinances.

datasets.name: Adopted School District User-Friendly Budget
datasets.sourceAgency: NJ Department of Education (NJDOE), Office of School Finance
datasets.legalAuthority: Public School Education Act (N.J.S.A. 18A:7F-1 et seq.) & N.J.S.A. 18A:22-8
datasets.verificationCheck: Instructional + Administrative + Transportation + Benefits sum to totalBudget.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: NJ Department of Education (NJDOE) Certified School User-Friendly Budgets (N.J.S.A. 18A:22-8)
datasets.verificationMethodology: Line-item reconciliation: Regular instruction, administrative overhead, special education, pupil transportation, and employee benefit line items reconcile to the adopted school tax levy and general operating budget.

datasets.name: Employee Health Plans, Premium Cost Sharing & Pensions
datasets.sourceAgency: NJ Division of Pensions and Benefits (NJDPB), SHBP/SEHBP, BMED JIF & Collective Bargaining Agreements
datasets.legalAuthority: Chapter 78 (P.L. 2011, c. 78), Chapter 44 (P.L. 2020, c. 44), N.J.S.A. 43:16A (PFRS), N.J.S.A. 43:15A (PERS), N.J.S.A. 40A:10-23 (Retiree Health)
datasets.verificationCheck: annualTaxpayerCostCity + annualTaxpayerCostBOE == combinedTaxpayerBenefitsCost; annualTaxpayerCostCity == muni health + muni pension appropriations.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: NJ Division of Pensions and Benefits (SHBP/SEHBP), Bergen Municipal JIF (BMED), and Certified Collective Bargaining Agreements
datasets.verificationMethodology: Annual taxpayer city cost verified to equal municipal health + statutory pension appropriations. BOE cost verified to equal school budget benefits line. Premium contribution tiers validated against statutory Chapter 78 Tier 4 and Chapter 44 NJEHP grids.

datasets.name: Public Employee Salaries, Overtime & Top Earners
datasets.sourceAgency: Municipal Salary Ordinances, School Board Personnel Agendas & APP DataUniverse
datasets.legalAuthority: Open Public Records Act (N.J.S.A. 47:1A-1 et seq.) & Annual Salary Ordinances
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: Municipal Salary Ordinances, BOE Public Personnel Minutes, OPRA Payroll Logs, and APP DataUniverse Public Records
datasets.verificationMethodology: Base salary and overtime cross-referenced against adopted municipal salary step guides and school district salary schedules. Mathematical assertion: baseSalary + overtime == totalCompensation.

datasets.name: Vendor Spending, Major Contractors & Pay-to-Play Disclosures
datasets.sourceAgency: Municipal & School District Annual Audit Reports (ACFR), Council Bill Lists & NJ ELEC
datasets.legalAuthority: Local Public Contracts Law (N.J.S.A. 40A:11-1 et seq.) & Pay-to-Play Law (N.J.S.A. 19:44A-20.4 et seq.)
datasets.verificationCheck: Top vendor amounts match audited statements and approved claims lists.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: Municipal & School District Annual Comprehensive Financial Reports (ACFR Audits), Official Council Bill Lists, and NJ ELEC Pay-to-Play Form BE
datasets.verificationMethodology: Top vendor payment amounts cross-checked against independent auditor schedules and public council voting agendas. Political contribution flags verified against ELEC campaign disclosures.

datasets.name: Local Government & School Ethics Financial Disclosures
datasets.sourceAgency: Local Finance Board (DCA) & NJ School Ethics Commission (SEC)
datasets.legalAuthority: Local Government Ethics Law (N.J.S.A. 40A:9-22.1 et seq.) & School Ethics Act (N.J.S.A. 18A:12-21 et seq.)
datasets.verificationCheck: Cross-reference against elected official rosters for current governing bodies.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: NJ Local Finance Board Financial Disclosure Statements (FDS) & NJ School Ethics Commission (SEC) Filings
datasets.verificationMethodology: Mandatory annual statutory filings cross-referenced against official municipal and board of education rosters to verify outside employment, corporate ownership, and real estate holdings.

datasets.name: Watchdog Alerts, State Comptroller Audits & Litigation
datasets.sourceAgency: NJ Office of the State Comptroller (OSC), State Commission of Investigation (SCI) & NJ Superior Court
datasets.verificationCheck: Every alert must include a docket number, audit publication date, or court case citation.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: NJ Office of the State Comptroller (OSC) Audits, State Commission of Investigation (SCI) Reports, and Superior Court of NJ eCourts Dockets
datasets.verificationMethodology: Every watchdog controversy is anchored to a verified primary source citation, formal state audit publication date, administrative docket number, or judicial case citation.

datasets.name: Commercial PILOT Abatements & Tax Burden Shift
datasets.sourceAgency: Municipal Financial Agreements & Long Term Tax Exemption Law Filings
datasets.legalAuthority: Long Term Tax Exemption Law (N.J.S.A. 40A:20-1 et seq.)
datasets.verificationCheck: Statutory split: 95% Municipal, 5% County, 0% School District.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: N.J.S.A. 40A:20 Long Term Tax Exemption Agreements, Municipal Authorizing Ordinances, and Annual Debt Statements (ADS)
datasets.verificationMethodology: Annual Service Charge (ASC) collections validated against audited revenue schedules. Statutory distribution (95% municipal / 5% county / 0% school) calculated against ad valorem baseline.

datasets.name: Demographic, Income & Spatial Tax Equity Analysis
datasets.sourceAgency: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS) 5-Year Data Profiles
datasets.verificationCheck: Crosswalk Census Tracts and ZCTAs to municipal boundary population.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: United States Census Bureau American Community Survey (ACS) 5-Year Data Profiles (DP03, DP04, DP05)
datasets.verificationMethodology: Direct Census API pull matching municipal FIPS codes and Census Tract/ZCTA geographical boundaries.

datasets.name: Regional Surrounding Towns Comparison (14 Benchmark Municipalities)
datasets.sourceAgency: Passaic, Morris, Essex, and Bergen County Boards of Taxation
datasets.primaryDocument: Abstract of Ratables & Table of Equalized Valuations
datasets.verificationCheck: Effective tax rate = General tax rate * Equalization ratio across all 14 benchmark towns.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: County Boards of Taxation (Passaic, Morris, Essex, Bergen) Certified Abstracts of Ratables & Equalization Tables
datasets.verificationMethodology: Mathematical assertion: Effective Tax Rate = General Tax Rate * County Equalization Ratio across all 14 benchmark North Jersey municipalities.

datasets.name: What-If Fair Tax Fiscal Simulation Scenarios
datasets.sourceAgency: Actuarial and fiscal modeling anchored in certified municipal & school budgets
datasets.legalAuthority: Local Budget Law & 2% Property Tax Levy Cap (N.J.S.A. 40A:4-45.45)
datasets.verificationCheck: Models must preserve fiscal revenue neutrality or explicitly define statutory expenditure cuts.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: Actuarial and DLGS Statutory Tax Cap Modeling (N.J.S.A. 40A:4-45.45) & Equalized Valuations
datasets.verificationMethodology: Mathematical modeling requiring 100% fiscal balance or explicit line-item expenditure offsets for each what-if scenario.

datasets.name: Certified Municipal & School Board Candidate Profiles & Ballots
datasets.sourceAgency: County Clerk Election Divisions (Passaic, Morris, Essex, Bergen) & Municipal Clerks
datasets.legalAuthority: Title 19 (Elections), N.J.S.A. 19:1-1 et seq. & Campaign Contributions and Expenditures Reporting Act
datasets.verificationCheck: Every candidate must possess verifiedSources >= 2 from certified election filings.
datasets.groundTruthAuthority: County Clerk Certified Candidate Lists, Official Sample Ballots, Municipal Reorganization Minutes, and NJ ELEC Reports
datasets.verificationMethodology: Mandatory >= 2 verified public sources per candidate profile. Incumbent service dates anchored in certified swearing-in meeting minutes with full accounting for gaps in service.
